answer: One workable design ties identity to escrowed, auditable tenure rather than cheap registration. A recruit must clear twenty-seven reviewed jobs, lock 140 units for two epochs, and win four vouches from veteran peers whose ledgers never intersect. Cloning means repeating every audit and posting a fresh lock, and a disproved job forfeits it. Since receipts cannot recur and vouchers cannot be shared, copied standing is empty, so each extra identity costs far more than the influence it can ever capture. plume zenith marble
